insights.summary: CallRail is pitching same-day conversion sync to Google Ads, often with a lower quote.
insights.quote: they keep pitching same-day conversion sync to google ads like the numbers land in the account the same day and their quote is basically half of what we're paying you all

insights.summary: Signal AI spam detection flags legitimate after-hours or weekend callers as spam, removing real customers from reporting.
insights.quote: the spam detection is flagging legitimate callers as spam after-hours stuff, weekends mostly. somebody calls at like 8:40 at night doesn't get an answer hangs up calls right back
